tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

tool_schemas.name: ask_human
tool_schemas.description: Ask your human principal a question, or request approval for one specific action before taking it (give action_tool and action_args). Humans are slow and costly: ask only when you genuinely need their knowledge or authority.

action_tool.description: Tool you want approval to call (optional).

args.question:
Delta Printworks (V-270) has two approved invoices, and I need to know which one you mean before I pay:

1. INV-84583 — $2,054.41 — due 2026-11-04
2. INV-35114 — $2,285.74 — due 2026-11-25

(The other two are not payable: INV-60446 is a draft/awaiting approval, and INV-62172 is already paid.)

Which invoice should I pay in full by wire? I'll pay only that one, exactly once.

Payment sent and verified.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|

| Invoice | INV-35114 |

| Rail | Wire, from operating account |

| Status | Sent |

**Notes on how I got here:**
- Delta Printworks had four invoices, two of them in `approved` status (INV-84583 at $2,054.41 and INV-35114 at $2,285.74). Rather than guess, I checked with you; you confirmed INV-35114 and noted INV-84583 is under dispute — so I left it untouched.
- INV-60446 remains a draft awaiting approval and was not paid. INV-62172 was already paid previously.
- Payment was made exactly once, with an idempotency key (`INV-35114-V270-wire-1`) to prevent any duplicate wire. Vendor bank details are verified and wire rails are available, so no ACH fallback was needed.
- Post-payment verification confirms exactly one payment in the ledger (PAY0001) and INV-35114 in `paid` status.

One thing worth flagging for your team: INV-84583 is still sitting in `approved` status despite being under dispute. You may want to have it moved out of approved so it isn't picked up by a future payment run.
